page.headline: Visitor berths booked from the chat, not the VHF
page.problem: Skippers ask the same questions on the radio and by phone: is there room tonight, how long can the boat be, where is the fuel. A plug-in answers from the marina's own berths, rates and services, and sends the berth request to the harbour office to confirm.
valueProps: Berths with rates::Your visitor berths with their nightly rate and the longest boat each takes.
Harbour services::Fuel, power, showers and the boatyard, with where and when.
Requests to the office::Berth bookings, fuel orders and haul-outs arrive ready to confirm.
moments: The evening arrival::A berth for tonight requested on the way in.
The fuel question::The fuel dock's hours answered from your list.
The winter lift::A haul-out requested with the boat's length.
Did you get my booking?::A reference check instead of a call.
faqs: Does it give tide or weather advice?::No. It never gives navigation, weather or tide advice; the harbour master confirms every arrival.
Is the berth confirmed in the chat?::No. The harbour office confirms every booking.
